title: NetBird
author: Marcus Quinn <marcus@marcusquinn.com>
description: Self-hosted WireGuard mesh VPN with SSO, MFA, and granular access controls. Connect devices into a secure peer-to-peer overlay network.
tagline: Zero-config WireGuard mesh VPN for teams

NETBIRD_PORT.title: NetBird client transport
NETBIRD_PORT.description: TLS port for native NetBird management, signal, and relay traffic. Accepts only post-quantum TLS 1.3 (X25519MLKEM768) unless NETBIRD_TLS_ALLOW_CLASSIC=true is set; requires NetBird clients 0.61.0 or later.

PROXY_PORT.title: Optional reverse-proxy ingress
PROXY_PORT.description: Raw TLS backend for the documented second-IP host bridge. Keep disabled until host firewall protection is installed.

STUN_PORT.title: Optional dedicated STUN
STUN_PORT.description: Leave disabled to use Cloudron's platform STUN service. Enable only to run NetBird's own STUN server on this UDP port; it must not be 3478 when Cloudron TURN uses that port.

postInstallMessage:
NetBird is running. Visit the app URL to access the dashboard.

On first run, create and test the embedded owner account before adding another login method.

Connect clients with `netbird up --management-url https://${CLOUDRON_APP_DOMAIN}:${NETBIRD_PORT} --setup-key YOUR_SETUP_KEY --enable-rosenpass --rosenpass-permissive`, or copy the command from the dashboard's Add Peer dialog, which includes the same flags. Keep TCP port ${NETBIRD_PORT} enabled and accessible for native client traffic.

The client port accepts only post-quantum TLS, so use NetBird clients 0.61.0 or later. The Rosenpass flags add post-quantum keys to tunnels between devices that have it, and still connect to devices that don't. In the desktop app, turn on Enable Quantum-Resistance and Enable Permissive Mode under Settings > Security > Encryption.

NAT traversal uses Cloudron's platform STUN service unless you enabled the optional dedicated STUN port.

<sso>Creating the owner account at /setup also adds Cloudron as a login option. New Cloudron users wait for your approval under Team > Users. Keep the owner account as the recovery login.</sso>
